title: RateDisciplineRecord v1 — one message's standing at one peer's rate door: when it was judged, the sender and traffic class (gossip, task, or other) and the message's size in bytes as they stood when judged (null where a malformed judgement carried nothing usable), the verdict — admitted (within every quota and size bound) or throttled — and, for a throttled message, the named reason: malformed, oversized, quota_gossip, quota_task, quota_total, quota_bytes, or throttled (the sender is inside a throttle cooldown a quota breach earned); names, classes, sizes, and counts only, never payload content (Y-060)
